drives.heading: Drive moderation
drives.intro: Approving is how a drive goes live. The company must be verified or have documents waiting for review (then the drive goes live at limited reach), must not be suspended, and needs at least the cost of one check-in in its balance. Anything blocking it is listed on the drive.

jobs.intro: Jobs that used up their retries, from every queue. Retrying is safe: alerts claim before sending, and charges and top-ups are keyed so a second run changes nothing.

pricing.intro: Prices are rows, never edits: a new price takes effect from now and every check-in is charged at the price in effect when the person arrived.

ledger.heading: Ledger
ledger.intro: Append-only and double-entry: every transaction's debits equal its credits, which the database checks on commit. Balance is always credits minus debits, so platform accounts that hold money read negative.
ledger.unbalanced: {count, plural, one {# transaction doesn't} other {# transactions don't}} balance. This should be impossible; investigate before anything else.

verification.heading: Company verification
verification.intro: Companies send their GSTIN and documents, and you decide. The automatic check shown on each is a mock: it only checks the GSTIN's format and looks nothing up, so treat it as a typo check, not evidence. A company waiting here can run drives at limited reach.

moderation.intro: Reports grouped by what they're about, most recent first. Nothing happens to a drive or a person until you act here. A logged-out reporter is known only by network, and one network can be a whole venue's Wi-Fi or thousands of phones behind a carrier, so weigh those counts lightly.

neverPay.heading: Walkins never charges candidates
neverPay.body: No employer should ask you for money: not for registration, training, a uniform, a document or a job letter. If anyone does, don't pay.
neverPay.howToReport: If anyone asks you for money, open that drive's page and use Report this drive. You don't need to sign in.

drive.heading: Report this drive
drive.intro: Tell Walkins if something about this drive is wrong. You don't need an account, and the employer won't see who reported it.
drive.chooseReason: Choose what's wrong, then send the report.
drive.detailsHint: Up to 500 characters. Only Walkins reads this.
drive.thanks: Thank you. Walkins will look at this drive. If someone asked you for money, please don't pay them.
drive.failed: The report didn't go through. Check your signal and try again.

candidate.question: Report {name} to Walkins? They won't be told who reported them, and nothing changes for them until Walkins has looked.
candidate.failed: The report didn't go through. Try again.

warning.heading: A notice from Walkins
warning.company: Walkins has had reports about your company's drives: {reason, select, ASKS_FOR_MONEY {asking candidates for money} NOT_A_REAL_JOB {a job that isn't real} MISLEADING_PAY {pay that doesn't match the listing} ABUSIVE {abusive behaviour} FAKE_PROFILE {a profile that isn't genuine} other {something else}}. Nothing has been suspended. Please check your listings so every drive is exactly what it says.
warning.candidate: An employer reported a problem with your account: {reason, select, ASKS_FOR_MONEY {asking candidates for money} NOT_A_REAL_JOB {a job that isn't real} MISLEADING_PAY {pay that doesn't match the listing} ABUSIVE {abusive behaviour} FAKE_PROFILE {a profile that isn't genuine} other {something else}}. Nothing has changed, and you can keep booking walk-ins. This is a notice so you know.

standing.suspendedBody: Walkins is looking into reports about your company, so its drives are paused and nothing can be changed for now. You can still see everything, and it all stays as it was. Candidates who booked have been told the drive is paused, not why.
standing.limited: {company} isn't verified yet, so each drive's alerts reach only the nearest {limit} candidates who match. Once Walkins approves your documents, alerts reach everyone who matches.
standing.rejected: {company}'s verification wasn't accepted, so new drives can't go live. Your verification page says why and lets you send documents again.
standing.unsubmitted: {company} hasn't sent documents for verification, so its drives can't go live yet. Once you send them, drives can go live while you wait, at limited reach.

verification.heading: Verification

explain.UNSUBMITTED: Send your GSTIN and your GST registration certificate. Until you do, drives can't go live.
explain.PENDING: Your drives can go live while you wait, but each one's alerts reach only the nearest candidates. That limit lifts once Walkins approves you.
explain.VERIFIED: Your drives reach everyone they match, and candidates see that you're verified.
explain.REJECTED: The reason is below. Fix it and send your documents again; the earlier submission stays on record.

verification.howChecked: A person at Walkins looks at your documents and decides. An automatic check runs too, but here it is a stand-in that only checks the GSTIN's format; it doesn't look your company up in the GST registry.
verification.ownerOnly: Only an owner of your company can send verification documents.
verification.sentLine: Sent {day}{name, select, other { by {name}}} · {documents, plural, =0 {no documents} one {# document} other {# documents}}

rejection.DOCUMENT_UNREADABLE: A document couldn't be read. Send a clearer scan or photo.
rejection.DETAILS_DONT_MATCH: The details on the documents don't match the company's name or GSTIN. Check they match, then send them again.
rejection.GSTIN_INVALID: The GSTIN couldn't be confirmed. Check it against your GST certificate.
rejection.NOT_A_BUSINESS: The documents don't show a registered business. Send your GST registration certificate.

form.heading: Send documents
form.gstinHint: 15 characters, as on your GST certificate.
form.documentsHint: Your GST registration certificate, and anything else that shows the business. PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB each, at most {max}.
form.tooLarge: {name} is over 5 MB. Send a smaller scan or photo.
form.uploadFailed: A document didn't upload. Check your signal and try again.
form.failed: Your documents couldn't be sent. Try again.
